Adaptive footing follows the exact main outline. Preview terrain seats the mapped outline plus a small estimated threshold/step rectangle filling the mapped entrance recess, with1.5 m margin. The runtime cutout uses those same two polygons. Exact plinth, forecourt paving, step risers and current grade joins are unverified; normal DEM is a coarse fixture, not a survey.
